content: Emaho!Upon the lotus stalk in the center of the lake,The deity of the spontaneously accomplished five kāyas and wisdoms,The great self-arisen Padma in union of father and mother,Amidst gathering clouds of ḍākinīs, I pray to you:Grant your blessings so that my aspirations may be swiftly fulfilled!Generated by the power of the ripening of negative actions,The assembly of sickness, harmful spirits, obstacles, war, and famine,May they be exhausted the very moment I remember your face;O Lord of Uḍḍiyāna, I exhort you from my heart to keep your promise:Grant your blessings so that my aspirations may be swiftly fulfilled!Familiarity with faith, ethical discipline, and generosity,Liberation of the mind through learning, conscience, and shame,These seven noble riches, the excellence of wisdom—May they fully enter the mind-streams of all sentient beings,And grant relief so that the world may be filled with happiness;Grant your blessings so that my aspirations may be swiftly fulfilled!Whenever there are illnesses, sufferings, or unwanted circumstances,Harm from elemental spirits, punishments from kings,Fears of fire, water, wild beasts, and perilous paths—In all such moments, even when life has reached its very end,Since I have no other refuge or hope,Hold me with your compassion, O Guru, Lord of Uḍḍiyāna;Grant your blessings so that my aspirations may be swiftly fulfilled!I pray to the Precious One of Uḍḍiyāna:May adverse conditions and obstacles not arise,May favorable conditions and aspirations be fulfilled,And may you bestow the supreme and common accomplishments.
